source: NISAR Hazard Watch exploration computed by the backend on NISAR L-band scenes. Diagnostic evidence, not a validated classifier; no cause, probability, hectares or displacement is reported.

radar.comparator: Target minus median of the prior measured dates

matches.criterion: unique baseline co-/cross-pol levels within declared dB tolerance; at most 128 nearest candidates; contrast uses matched positives only; not causal matching on all confounders

HH.interval_limit: Conditional resampling of fixed spatial blocks; spatial independence, measurement errors, reference errors and causal identification are not established
HH.definition: Mean cellwise target-minus-baseline change in matched focal cells minus matched controls.

HV.interval_limit: Conditional resampling of fixed spatial blocks; spatial independence, measurement errors, reference errors and causal identification are not established
HV.definition: Mean cellwise target-minus-baseline change in matched focal cells minus matched controls.

HV_over_HH.interval_limit: Conditional resampling of fixed spatial blocks; spatial independence, measurement errors, reference errors and causal identification are not established
HV_over_HH.definition: Mean cellwise target-minus-baseline change in matched focal cells minus matched controls.

synchrony.conditioning: Largest focal-mean assessment bracket held fixed. Contrast-step selection sensitivity is reported separately.
Largest focal-mean assessment bracket held fixed. Contrast-step selection sensitivity is reported separately.
Largest focal-mean assessment bracket held fixed. Contrast-step selection sensitivity is reported separately.

observation.reason: Sensor and speckle uncertainty are unestimated.

spatial.scope: Conditional resampling of fixed spatial blocks with complete channel histories.
spatial.limitations: Block independence, sensor errors, reference errors and selection-adjusted intervals are unestimated.

model.reason: No crop or management model is fitted.

needed: Dated harvest, tillage or irrigation records for the focal area.
Parcel boundaries, crop context and dated optical vegetation observations.

questions: Did the focal patch change differently from baseline-matched surrounding cells?
Which observed interval contains the strongest focal-minus-control step?
Did focal cells change together within that sampled interval?

spectral.reason: Need at least six observed dates

stochastic.interpretation: Conditional empirical-Bayes latent-state distribution at observed dates. The representative regional process uses the fitted pixel covariance. Bands omit parameter and model uncertainty. Residual scale is not measured sensor noise.

agriculture.comparison: Local annulus on the same dates and fixed measured support

aoiSummary.definition: Cells where the target departs from the observed baseline by more than the diagnostic half-width in any polarization; descriptive, not a classification.

layers.title: agriculture step magnitude db HV over HH

limitations: Diagnostic evidence from measured L-band radar backscatter, not a validated classifier.
Departures are measured against the scene's own observed baseline, which may include change.
No forecast, probability, cause, area in hectares or displacement is reported.
